name: North American women's league (2026)
author: BallGM
description: A hard-capped league at the 2026 agreement's figures: a 7,000,000 cap with no exceptions above it, a 1,400,000 maximum, 12-player rosters, 44 games, eight playoff teams seeded league-wide. Figures in US dollars.

fidelity.detail: This league plays four 10-minute quarters; the match engine plays four 12-minute quarters, so per-game totals run about a fifth high. Rates (per possession, per 36 minutes, percentages) compare fairly.

fidelity.rule: Playoff home pattern (1-1-1 in the first round)
fidelity.detail: One home-court pattern serves every round; the preset uses 2-2-1-1-1, so the higher seed hosts games 1 and 2 of the best-of-three rather than 1 and 3.
The agreement's minimums run from 270,000 to 300,000 by service; the preset steps once, at three seasons.
Two spots outside the cap and the 12-player roster (Milestone 8 auxiliary slots).

fidelity.rule: Lottery odds from two seasons' combined record
fidelity.detail: The four non-playoff teams' odds (44.2%, 27.6%, 17.8%, 10.4%) apply to this season's table alone.
This build requires a retained-round rule wherever there is a draft; the preset states the loosest one, a single first-round pick kept across the four tradable drafts.
Playoff seeding is league-wide, so the fictional league is one flat table; a league pack with two conferences would play conference brackets and a final instead.
The cap grows each season with league revenue; the preset holds the 2026 figure.

fidelity.rule: Core designation and the in-season cup
fidelity.detail: No designated-player rights and no in-season cup.
Most-valuable-player and the other voted awards need AI voters (Milestone 9); the preset hands out statistical titles instead.
